messages.body_plain:
Has anyone had any luck connecting to a Herokupostgres standalone data with 
RPostgreSQL?

I've successfuly connected using command line psql and pgAdmin3 but when I 
try with the following code

library(RPostgreSQL)

drv <- dbDriver("PostgreSQL")

con <- dbConnect(drv,
  dbname="db",
  user = "user",
  password="pwd",
  host="host",
  port=5432,
)

with or with out the argument

 options="sslmode=require"

I get 

Error in postgresqlNewConnection(drv, ...) : 
  RS-DBI driver: (could not connect...

Note I have replaced the actual host, password user values etc for the 
purpose of this post

Any help is really appreciated as I am not sure how to proceed from here (I 
am an experienced R programmer but am new to PostgreSQL)

Joe
